title: MDG Operations Snapshot v1
description: A normalized, point-in-time observation of MDG operational state, derived from raw private source inputs (Hermes board export, workflow status). The snapshot preserves raw_state verbatim alongside normalized_state so analysis never silently rewrites source meaning. Derived and non-authoritative: Hermes Kanban remains the sole live task authority. A snapshot never changes live state.

snapshot_id.description: Deterministic identifier derived from source_sha256 + observed_at. Re-observing identical source at the same observed_at yields the same snapshot_id (idempotent).

observed_at.description: Observation time (UTC). Distinct from any event occurrence time. Monotonic non-decreasing.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonicalized raw source inputs. Identical hash => no new events on re-observation.

is_first_trustworthy_observation.description: True for the first snapshot whose inputs are trustworthy. Pre-existing tasks become left-censored at this point; their state-entry times are unknown and must not be inferred.

prior_snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the previous trustworthy snapshot, or null on first observation.

coverage_state.description: Honest coverage of this observation. Empty or unsupported measurement resolves to insufficient_data, never zero.

tasks.description: Normalized task records. Duplicate task_id within a snapshot is rejected.

raw_state.description: Verbatim status/state string from the source system (e.g. Hermes 'done', 'running', 'ready', 'todo', 'blocked'). Preserved unchanged so normalization is auditable.

normalized_state.description: Analysis vocabulary. CRITICAL: Hermes raw_state 'done' maps to 'card_completed', NOT to 'released'. 'released' is reserved for a verified production release evidenced separately.

completion.description: Six distinct, non-equivalent completion/release concepts. Each is independently true/false; none implies another without its own evidence.

card_completed.description: The Hermes card reached a terminal done state. This is NOT a website release.

initiative_completed.description: The parent initiative's defined outcome was achieved. Distinct from any single card.

verification_pass.description: An independent verifier recorded PASS. Missing verifier evidence is false, never assumed true.

accepted_candidate.description: A reviewed candidate commit was accepted by the coordinator after verifier PASS.

integration_completed.description: The sole integrator merged the candidate to origin/main. A pushed branch is not an integration.

verified_production_release.description: A verified production release per MDG governance: integration + post-deploy verification + release evidence. The ONLY concept that counts toward release throughput. A terminal planning/recon/docs/verification card is NOT a release.

left_censored.description: Task existed before first trustworthy observation; entry time to current state is unknown.

right_censored.description: Task has not reached the terminal state of interest by window end.

unknown_state_entry_time.description: The time the task entered its current normalized_state cannot be established from trustworthy data.

state_entry_time.description: Trustworthy time the task entered normalized_state, or null when unknown. MUST be null for left-censored tasks. NEVER inferred from card update timestamps, comments, Git commit dates, file mtimes, or prose handoffs.
